security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://esi.evetech.net https://api.eve-scout.com

bundle.shortDescription: Offline-first map and tactical analysis for New Eden
bundle.longDescription: A private, offline-first map of New Eden built from CCP's Static Data Export. The map, routing and analysis work with no network and no account; public ESI layers are optional and always displayed with their age.
